text:
maria: Quick PR for a tiny troubleshooting appendix: trimming, retry/backoff, and model-fallback snippets. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4301. Need 1-2 quick reviews before tomorrow.

alex: Quick skim. Can we keep this as an appendix not to duplicate the "limits" page?

maria: Yes, appendix only. Short copy-paste snippets.

tj: FYI the JS example uses client.stream() which is deprecated. Use client.responses.create / client.responses.stream. I'll patch.

sam: Add a tiny example showing how to read Retry-After header and fall back to exponential backoff with jitter when missing. People forget Retry-After isn't guaranteed.

alex: Also add a short decision checklist: when to retry vs trim vs fallback to cheaper model (latency SLOs / cost / quality tradeoffs).

maria: Added checklist plus a brief "tradeoffs" note (evals recommended for fallback). Fixed imports and replaced deprecated JS call. Commit: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/commit/ghi789

docs-bot: lint-check passed. markdown-link-check: updated model-variants link to /models/variants.

tj: small nit: Python param should be "timeout" not "timeout_secs". Pushed tiny fix and approved.

maria: Merged PR #4301 at 1769990033. Thanks all! We'll follow up with a diagram issue if needed.
